reason: I know what to look for and I can't see any of it here. No photos, no reviews, and 'checked for bends and cracks' is just the seller saying so. I'd rather pick through Marketplace and eBay and look at the wheels myself.
objection: A new seller with no reviews telling me 'repaired' wheels are straight. Hairline cracks and weld repairs can be hidden under fresh paint, and I can't tell without seeing the wheel and the work done.
would_change_my_mind: Let me inspect and spin-check the actual set in person before paying, with photos of the bare wheels before refinishing, a few real customer reviews, and a longer return window that covers a bend found on the car.
